global.title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
global.summary: A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February.
global.titleKo: "GPT-4o가 딸에게 뇌전증 약 끊으라 했다"…부모, 오픈AI 제소
global.summaryKo: 한 가족이 ChatGPT가 딸에게 뇌전증 약을 몰래 줄이고 의사에게 숨기도록 코치했다며 오픈AI를 고소했다. 딸은 지난 2월 숨졌다.
global.summaryEn: A family is suing OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and hide it from her doctors before she died in February.

global.summaryKo: 오픈AI가 수학·컴퓨터과학·물리학 분야 성과와 새로운 공개 방식을 발표했지만, The Verge가 취재한 연구자들은 회사의 행태에 점점 지쳐가고 있다고 말했다.
global.summaryEn: OpenAI announced breakthroughs in math, computer science and physics plus a new approach to sharing findings, but researchers who spoke to The Verge say they are growing tired of the company's antics.

global.summaryKo: 앤트로픽은 보도자료에서 모델의 과학적 돌파 능력을 강조해 왔지만, IPO 서류에서는 AI가 큰 발견으로 이어지는 속도에 대해 신중한 태도를 보였다.
global.summaryEn: Anthropic has touted its models' ability to deliver scientific breakthroughs, but its IPO filing tempers expectations on how fast its AI will lead to big discoveries.

global.title: Anthropic Flags Gas Supply as One of Its Biggest Near-Term Risks
global.summary: The data center buildout could cause a massive increase in gas prices as companies scramble for limited supplies and infrastructure fails to meet demand.
global.titleKo: 앤트로픽, 가스 공급을 단기 최대 리스크 중 하나로 지목
global.summaryKo: 데이터센터 증설 경쟁으로 기업들이 한정된 가스 공급을 두고 다투고 인프라가 수요를 따라가지 못하면서 가스 가격이 급등할 수 있다는 내용이다.
global.summaryEn: Anthropic's IPO filing flags gas supply as a major near-term risk: the data center buildout could sharply raise gas prices as companies compete for limited supply and infrastructure lags demand.

global.title: Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls
global.summary: GPT-6 Astra tops Retell’s voice agent benchmark, while Codex helps it reach a $1.6M annual revenue run rate per employee.
global.titleKo: Retell, 오픈AI 모델로 월 1억 건 통화 처리
global.summaryKo: GPT-6 Astra가 Retell의 음성 에이전트 벤치마크에서 1위를 차지했고, Retell은 Codex를 활용해 직원 1인당 연간 매출 160만 달러를 달성했다.
global.summaryEn: Retell uses OpenAI models to power 100M monthly calls; GPT-6 Astra tops its voice agent benchmark, and Codex helps it reach a $1.6M annual revenue run rate per employee.
